messages:
aj: FYI seeing repeated quota hits when clients reconnect to SSE. Console shows a 'stream resumed' UX but billing shows a new session charge each resume. Repro: 1) start stream, 2) kill TCP, 3) reconnect -> console says resumed, billing increments. Logs: https://internal/logs/abc123 :point_right:
maria: Seen this in dedicated yesterday too. Suspect proxy is not propagating resume token into billing pipeline so it treats resume as new session. Also request headers lost on reconnect occasionally.
sam: Quick Q — when we say 'sticky routing' for resumes, do we stick by tenant+resume-token or by ephemeral connection id? I thought we were routing by tenant only ATM.
ryan: We route by tenant + connection_id currently. Resume flow relies on resume_token to map KV cache and session state. If proxy changes conn_id on reconnect we end up creating a new billing session. That explains duplicate charge.
aj: snippet from proxy logs: `INFO conn=conn-17 resume_token=tok-9 mapped_session=session-42` then billing shows `new_session=session-90` a few ms later. So resume_token disappeared between layers.
deploy-bot: deploy started for org/streaming-proxy @ 1754323000 — rolling 3 pods (canary first).
maria: Proposal: add explicit `x-resume-id` header on the client resume handshake and ensure the proxy attaches it to the downstream billing/event pipeline as `resume_id` tag. Also dedupe billing events server-side if resume_id seen within 60s.
sam: dedupe at billing layer sounds safest. Also we should consider sticky routing by resume_id for a short TTL so requests land on same backend to avoid state mismatch.
aj: rollout plan sketch: 1) small PR to proxy to copy resume_token->x-resume-id 2) billing change to accept resume_id tag and dedupe 3) canary 10% traffic + dashboard panel for "resume duplicates" 4) enable globally after 48h of no regressions. I'll draft the PR.
ryan: I'll own the canary and dashboards. Which metrics do we want? I think: resume_id_count, duplicate_billing_count, resume_success_rate, avg_time_to_resume(ms).
maria: I'll open PR for proxy header and add unit tests for header passthrough. PR link: https://internal/pulls/4321
sam: Also add an alert: duplicate_billing_count > 5/min for any tenant -> pager. We don't want silent double-charges.
aj: agree. Also update console UX: show resume_id in the streaming session details so support can correlate with billing/telemetry quickly.
ryan: noted. I'll add a temporary trace that surfaces resume_id in the stream trace view.
maria: thanks — moving to action items. :thumbsup:
